events.title: Crystal Bowersox Meet & Greet
events.description: Join us at The Mockingbird on Mill Road for a special Meet & Greet with national recording artist and American Idol finalist Crystal Bowersox. A Northwest Ohio native who grew up just a few miles from The Mockingbird, Crystal will be available from 12:00–3:00 PM for photos, autographs, questions, and conversation. The Mockingbird's full food and drink menu will be available for purchase throughout the event. Please note: this is a Meet & Greet and is not a concert or musical performance.
events.payment_note: Advance tickets are recommended. Food and drinks are sold separately.
events.image_alt: Crystal Bowersox Meet and Greet at The Mockingbird on Mill Road on Saturday, September 12 from 12 to 3 PM

events.title: Mockingbird Jam 2026
events.description: Mockingbird Jam is our 2026 community fundraiser for ALS research and families dealing with ALS. Join us for yoga at 9 AM, church service at 10 AM, live music from 11 AM to 8 PM, food trucks, basket raffles, and all-day fundraising throughout the property.
events.image_alt: Mockingbird Jam to Defeat ALS fundraiser graphic announcing Sunday, September 13 at The Mockingbird on Mill Road

events.title: Mockingbird Book Club — September
events.description: Join us for Mockingbird Book Club on Thursday, September 17th at 6:30 PM as we discuss The Woman in Suite 11 by Ruth Ware — the suspenseful follow-up to The Woman in Cabin 10. Travel journalist Lo Blacklock is invited to the opening of a luxurious hotel on Lake Geneva, where a late-night encounter with a mysterious woman pulls her into a dangerous situation involving secrets, deception, and a high-stakes pursuit across Europe. Enjoy an open, welcoming conversation with food and drinks available.
events.image_alt: Mockingbird Book Club event image for The Woman in Suite 11 by Ruth Ware, Thursday, September 17th at 6:30 PM
